header.running_head: The Abstinence of Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA)

blocks.text: Allaah's Rasool ﷺ. Behold! In a short period of time, Allaah shall grant you conquests over Persia and Rome. (You will then have so much wealth that) There will be those amongst you who will wear an outfit in the mornings and another in the evenings and a platter of food will be served to you in the mornings and again in the evenings." The Sahabah (RA) asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Are we in a better position today or in those days?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "You are certainly better off today as you will be during those days. Take note! If you knew about this world what I know, you would never be at ease with it."[^1]

Another narration from Hadhrat Khabbaab (RA) states that all that Hadhrat Mus'ab Bin Umayr (RA) left behind (after his death) was a sheet (so small) that (when it was used as a burial shroud, it) would leave his feet exposed, when his head was covered and his head exposed when his feet were covered. Rasulullaah ﷺ then instructed the Sahabah (RA) to cover his head with the sheet and his feet with Idhkhir grass.[^2]
The Abstinence of Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA)

Hadhrat Ibn Shihaab narrates that Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) once entered the Masjid wearing a striped shawl that he patched with a piece of leather because it tore. Seeing his pitiable condition Rasulullaah ﷺ started weeping and the Sahabah (RA) also started weeping upon the crying of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ then remarked, "What will be your condition at the time when one of you would wear an outfit in the morning and another in the evening. As one platter of food would be placed before him, another will be taken away and you will be decorating your homes as the Kabah is adorned." The Sahabah (RA) said, "We wish that such a time had already come so that we could enjoy ease and comfort." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "That time will certainly be coming. However, you are in a better position today that the people of those times."[^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that after Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) had passed away, Rasulullaah ﷺ came to him and bent over him as if advising him. Rasulullaah ﷺ then raised his head and signs of crying could be noticed from his eyes. Rasulullaah ﷺ then bent over (the corpse) again and when he raised his head, he was weeping. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ bent over him for the third time and when he raised his head this time, he was sobbing profusely. The Sahabah (RA) then understood that Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Madh'oon (RA) had certainly passed away and they all started to weep.
Abu Nu'aym in his Hilya (Vol.1 Pg.105).
